identity: An Arabic Wikipedia encyclopedia article about جائزة الملك فيصل العالمية (the King Faisal International Prize). Structure: (1) a lead paragraph that defines the prize, gives its founding dates, enumerates its five fields, then walks the first laureate in each field and closes with cumulative statistics; (2) a one-line section heading تاريخ الجائزة; (3) a long history paragraph covering 1975-1979, which embeds a verbatim oratorical quotation from a speech by الأمير خالد الفيصل that itself contains Quran 3:104 followed by a bracketed source citation (١٠٤ آل عمران 104); (4) a short closing paragraph on the 1981 addition of the medicine and science fields. Register is formal MSA expository prose, connective-heavy, with one embedded stretch of high oratorical register. 770 tokens, indices 0-769, with <NL> at 265, 268, 390, 732.
law: The sentence unit is the full predication that would have carried a final period in the source. Because punctuation is stripped, the load-bearing evidence is (a) verb-initial clauses with NO connective (تقرر, قال, عقدت, بلغ, تعلن, كان) which always open a new sentence; (b) fronted adverbials that reset the clock (لاحقا, في سنة X, بعد وفاة, من هذه المنطلقات) which likewise open; (c) the discourse particles إن and كما أن / كما يعد introducing an independent new subject; against (d) the huge mass of intra-sentential واو. The واو test I applied: واو + verb or واو + phrase that merely ELABORATES the event already stated (a trailing date tag وكان ذلك سنة..., a manner tag وكان ذلك بالمشاركة, a resumptive وذلك, a coordinate second decision وحدد, a list item والآخر, a hal clause وقد + perfect) stays inside the sentence with a comma; واو introducing a genuinely NEW proposition with a new subject, after the preceding predication is already semantically complete, opens a new sentence (واو الاستئناف). Subordinators حيث, إلا أن, على أن, التي, أن NEVER open a sentence. Bracketed citations attach to the sentence they document, so the sentence ends AFTER the citation, not before it. The heading تاريخ الجائزة is its own unit. Sentence length in this document runs roughly 12-55 tokens, mean about 26; a candidate reading that forces a 65-token sentence is evidence I have missed a boundary, and a candidate that produces a 6-token fragment is evidence I have invented one.
reasoning: SITE 58 (والأدب, before وتم منح أول جائزة). Rejected. The clause كانت في بدايتها تغطي ثلاث مجالات هي X وY وZ ends in a واو-list, and وتم منح أول جائزة سنة 1399 continues the same topic (the prize in its initial state). Reading it as one 25-token sentence with an internal comma is the natural Wikipedia shape; splitting would leave two thin halves and break the contrast with the following لاحقا sentence. The real boundary here is at 69, guaranteed by the fronted لاحقا at 70. SITES 101 and 128 (كما أن إحسان عباس, كما يعد ديفيد مورلي). Accepted. Each كما here carries its own explicit new subject and asserts a separate first-laureate fact parallel to كان أول من حاز; this is the standard sentence-opening كما of Arabic Wikipedia, not a correlative echo. SITE 147 (م, before وفي مجال العلوم فيعتبر). Accepted. The واو is followed by a fronted prepositional topic and then a resumptive فـ on فيعتبر, which is a sentence-level topicalization, and the preceding Morley statement is closed off by the appositive date tag وذلك سنة 1402. SITE 168 (بالمشاركة, before بينما كانت جانيت راولي). Accepted, LOW confidence, and this is the weakest call in the document. Arguments for: وكان ذلك بالمشاركة is a closing tag, بينما here introduces a topically new referent (the first woman) rather than a true contrast with sharing, and refusing the split forces a 48-token sentence, the longest in the lead by far. Arguments against: بينما is grammatically subordinating and this author is comma-happy. I split on the topic-shift reading. SITE 718 (المودودي, before بينما تسلم فؤاد سزكين). Rejected, and the asymmetry with 168 is deliberate: there بينما contrasts nothing, here it contrasts two named men at the SAME ceremony, X was represented by proxies WHILE Y collected his own award. True contrastive بينما is a comma; topic-shift بينما is a period. SITE 251 (دولة, before ومن الفائزين من نالوا). Accepted, medium. بلغ عدد... 275 فائزا يمثلون 43 دولة is a complete statistical assertion; ومن الفائزين introduces a wholly new fact about later Nobel recognition, not an elaboration of the count. SITE 344 (العربي, before وحدد سنة 1399). Rejected. تقرر... وحدد... are two verbs reporting the SAME Ramadan 1397 decision, the textbook case of coordinate elaboration. SITE 355 (before حيث). Rejected outright, حيث cannot open a sentence. This leaves a 52-token sentence at 326-377, long but internally chained تقرر / وحدد / حيث عقد / وتم فيه. SITE 377 (الجائزة, before وأقيمت على إثر ذلك مناسبة). Accepted, medium: a new event with a new subject after that chain is already complete. THE QUOTATION 400-612. The frame ذكر الأمير خالد الفيصل... في كلمة له took a colon, so 399 is NOT a boundary; the frame merges with the first quoted sentence. Inside, I cut where the oratory turns to a new assertion: 418 (والبر, before والأمة الإسلامية لم تحقق, new subject, واو الاستئناف, medium), 444 (الأرض, before قال الله تعالى, bare verb-initial, high), 485 (كلها, before the fronted من هذه المنطلقات whose main verb is أقيمت, high), 522 (بالعطاء, before إن الشهيد, the particle إن opening a fresh assertion, high), 547 (الحنيف, before ولقد حققت, ولقد is a strong oratorical sentence-opener, medium), 557 (إليه, before وجائزة الملك فيصل العالمية... إنما تأتي, medium, because refusing it would build a single 65-token period). SITE 461 vs 465 (المفلحون vs the citation 104). I ended the Quran sentence at 465, after ١٠٤ آل عمران 104, because that string is the stripped remains of a bracketed reference [آل عمران: 104] which belongs to the sentence it documents. SITE 585 (أجلها, before كما تأتي تجسيدا). Rejected, despite my accepting كما at 101 and 128. The difference is grammatical: there كما governed a new explicit subject, here كما تأتي has no subject of its own and merely echoes إنما تأتي from earlier in the same clause, a rhetorical parallelism inside one periodic sentence. SITE 638 (م, before وكان نتيجة ذلك فوز). Accepted, medium. وكان ذلك في شهر ربيع الأول... is a trailing date tag closing the committee sentence; وكان نتيجة ذلك opens the results. SITES 686 and 703. The stretch 664-731 is 68 tokens and cannot be one sentence. I cut at 686 (العزيز, before وحينها لم يتمكن, medium: new subject, and the ceremony statement is already complete) and at 703 (العام, before وقد أناب عنه, LOW: وقد + perfect is normally a circumstantial clause, but 687-703 closes as a self-contained aside about Maududi being unable to attend and dying months later, and the text then returns to the ceremony proper). That yields 23 / 17 / 28, matching the document mean. SITE 724 (بنفسه, before وكان ذلك الحفل الأول). Rejected, consistent with my treatment of every other وكان ذلك trailing tag (167, 291, 624). SITE 756 (م, before والآخر في العلوم). Rejected, أحدهما... والآخر... is a correlative pair inside one sentence, so the whole final paragraph 733-769 is a single sentence. Mandatory boundaries honoured at 264, 267, 389, 731 (each immediately before a <NL>) and at 769 (final token); no <NL> token itself carries a boundary. Result: 30 sentences over 766 non-<NL> tokens, mean 25.5.
